scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist
scripts.db:seed:local: node scripts/seed.mjs --out seed.generated.sql && wrangler d1 execute quipu-db --local --file=./seed.generated.sql
scripts.db:seed:prod: node scripts/seed.mjs --out seed.generated.sql && wrangler d1 execute quipu-db --remote --file=./seed.generated.sql
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npm run db:migrate:local && npm run db:seed:local
